Moves an environment's existing repository onto its dedicated worktree volume before
the pod mounts that volume over it. The runtime chart's init container runs it with
both volumes staged side by side under /mnt, where the claim cannot shadow the tree.

The tree is copied into the claim first and the original is set aside at
LEGACY_DIR.pre-worktree-volume only once the copy holds .git; it is never deleted.
A populated claim, a missing or symlinked LEGACY_DIR, or one that is not a
repository is left untouched, so every later boot is a no-op.

Usage:
  erun adopt-worktree LEGACY_DIR CLAIM_DIR [flags]

Examples:
  erun adopt-worktree /mnt/erun-home/git/petios /mnt/erun-worktree
  erun adopt-worktree --dry-run /mnt/erun-home/git/petios /mnt/erun-worktree

Flags:
      --dry-run   Resolve and trace mutating actions without executing them.
  -h, --help      help for adopt-worktree

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.
